name: SEO Content Pipeline
description: Full SEO content production pipeline. Starts with a competitor analysis to identify keyword gaps, then produces SEO articles and social posts — all routed to agents and synced to Plane.

steps.title: Competitor keyword gap analysis
steps.description_template: Competitor analysis for SEO: analyse top 5 competitors for {target_topic}. Identify keyword gaps and content opportunities for {brand_name}.

steps.title: Write primary SEO article
steps.description_template: 1,200-word SEO article for {brand_name} targeting keyword: {primary_keyword}. Industry: {industry}. Audience: {audience}.

steps.title: Social posts to promote content
steps.description_template: 5 social media posts (LinkedIn + Twitter/X) promoting the SEO article on {primary_keyword} for {brand_name}.
